plan_metadata.campaign_name: Targeted Evidence Expansion for Review & Transition Groups
plan_metadata.scope: Targeted calibration planning for AV1 groups whose behavior changes between baseline and strict scenarios in Op 946A (RandH, Smokindevil, Rob74K, Bi0hazard, Waldek)
plan_metadata.governance_notice: Planning and documentation artifact only. Zero modifications to active tiers, profile scores, Custom Formats, release restrictions, download rules, media files, or live automation.

target_groups.behavioral_transition_in_op946a: Shifts from allowed non-preferred fallback in baseline_current (4 titles) to strictly blocked in strict_candidate_only (0 titles).

proposed_titles.title: The Bourne Supremacy
proposed_titles.parity_rationale: Same-master 2160p UHD BluRay master. Evaluated in Op 943A baseline calibration (94.49 mean VMAF against Hallowed, 95.31 against MainFrame reference).
proposed_titles.known_caveats: MainFrame reference is high-bitrate x265 rather than raw remux; confirmed exact spatial/temporal alignment in Op 943A.

proposed_titles.title: Jack Reacher
proposed_titles.parity_rationale: Exact matching 3840x1600 active canvas, 23.976 fps, and HDR10 PQ metadata.
proposed_titles.known_caveats: No 1:1 Remux counterpart in current local library; planned initially as Hallowed-relative.

proposed_titles.title: Blade Runner
proposed_titles.parity_rationale: Matching 3840x1600 canvas and 23.976 fps on The Final Cut 4K master.
proposed_titles.known_caveats: Historical Op 921 eyeball audit noted blocky smoke at 8.23 Mbps; metric measurement will objectively quantify the degradation floor.

target_groups.behavioral_transition_in_op946a: Shifts from allowed non-preferred fallback in baseline_current (3 titles) to strictly blocked in strict_candidate_only (0 titles).
